[
  {
    "title": "TCS AGENTIC - Positive Testing: Verify successful LTE attach and detach procedures for multiple UEs under excellent radio conditions",
    "description": "Validate the end-to-end LTE attach and detach procedures for multiple UEs (at least 2) placed under excellent radio conditions as defined by LTE RSRP. The test shall be repeated for 10 iterations with 100% success rate expected.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network setup with a single isolated LTE cell activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off",
      "Multiple stationary UEs (real or emulated) placed at cell center under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6)",
      "End-to-end LTE setup operational without connectivity issues",
      "Test configuration parameters recorded"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages",
      "Power ON multiple UEs to initiate LTE attach procedure",
      "Wait for successful attach confirmation of all UEs (attach request and attach complete)",
      "Power OFF multiple UEs to initiate LTE detach procedure",
      "Wait for successful detach confirmation of all UEs (detach request and detach accept)",
      "Stop and save logs",
      "Repeat the above steps for a total of 10 iterations"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate for all UEs is 100% across 10 iterations",
      "Detach success rate for all UEs is 100% across 10 iterations",
      "Attach latency measured and recorded (minimum, average, maximum)",
      "UEs attached to correct cell verifying PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN as per test configuration",
      "Logs show correct signalling messages according to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze UE logs or UE applications for correct cell attachment",
      "Validate signaling messages captured in logs for attach and detach procedures",
      "Measure and record KPIs from logs including attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency"
    ]
  },

      "Test configuration parameters recorded"

    "testSteps": [
      "Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages",

      "Logs capture the secondary node release procedure with MN or SN initiated flows"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze UE logs or applications for correct LTE and NR cell attachment",
      "Validate signaling flows for attach, secondary node addition, detach and secondary node release procedures",
      "Measure and record KPIs for attach success, secondary node addition success, and detach success"
    ]
  },
